name: JavaScript
certifications: JS Institute JSE Certified Entry-Level JavaScript Programmer (JSE-40-01)
JS Institute JSA Certified Associate JavaScript Programmer (JSA-41-01)

beginner.summary: For people new to programming or new to JavaScript who want to write it confidently in the browser. Covers values and types, operators, functions, scope and closures, objects, arrays and their methods, strings, dates and Intl, destructuring, modules, the DOM, events and forms, promises, fetch and JSON, errors, developer tools and localStorage, ending with a small app built without a framework.
prerequisites: Uses a computer, files and folders and a modern web browser confidently
Has seen or edited a simple HTML page
No previous programming experience is required
outcomes: Write clear JavaScript with functions, objects, arrays, modules and modern operators
Build interactive pages with the DOM, events and validated forms
Load and save data with fetch, JSON, promises, async/await and localStorage
Find and fix bugs with browser developer tools and error handling

advanced.summary: For senior developers, tech leads and front-end architects responsible for large JavaScript products. Covers V8 internals and garbage collection, memory leak hunting, codebase and monorepo structure, micro-frontends and Web Components, bundler internals, Core Web Vitals at scale, npm supply-chain security, runtimes, WebAssembly, ES2025 and ES2026 features, shared-memory concurrency, observability, test strategy, planning a move to TypeScript and leading JavaScript teams.

Has worked in a codebase shared by several developers or teams
outcomes: Explain engine behaviour (JIT tiers, hidden classes, garbage collection) and fix speed and memory problems with evidence
